data.name: The Nest
data.detailed_description:
Answer the Call

An SOS draws you toward a remote island and the darkened manor overlooking its shore. Inside, the people who once lived and worked there have been transformed into violent creatures, enormous black feathers driven through their eyes and chests.

Search the estate, find those who remain, and uncover what has taken root within the manor before it spreads beyond the island.

Survive the Estate

Combat is fast, loud, and likely to attract more enemies. Fight with melee weapons, firearms, and explosives, or move carefully and slip past threats before they become overwhelming.

Use doors and chokepoints to control pursuit, prepare traps, and turn explosive barrels against groups of enemies. Search for coins and spend them at vending machines on ammunition, healing supplies, and armor. Resources are available, but survival depends on using them well.

The Manor Changes Behind You

Solve puzzles, collect keys, open locked chests, and uncover hidden passages throughout an interconnected estate. New discoveries lead back into familiar areas, where previously blocked routes, survivor interactions, and unexpected encounters may now be waiting.

A hallway does not remain safe simply because you have already survived it.

No One Is Guaranteed to Survive

Every survivor has a story shaped by earlier conversations and actions. Your choices influence where they appear, what they reveal, and whether their paths continue.

Survivors can be protected, abandoned, or killed by the creatures roaming the estate—and they are not protected from you. Save everyone, save no one, or escape with only a few. The nightmare can still be confronted, but who lives to see its end is not guaranteed.

data.short_description: Answer an SOS from a remote island and enter a manor consumed by a spreading nightmare. Fight transformed inhabitants, search for survivors, and uncover the truth in this first-person survival horror mystery.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 22H2, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX 6600 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Targets 1920×1080, Low preset, 30 FPS. Current GPU drivers required. Pre-release specifications.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 8 GB or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT 12 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Targets 1920×1080, Optimized/default preset, 60 FPS. Current GPU drivers required. Pre-release specifications.

content_descriptors.notes: The Nest contains frequent horror violence and blood and gore. Players use firearms, melee weapons, explosives, traps, and environmental hazards against transformed human enemies and other creatures. The game depicts corpses, trap-related deaths, disturbing bodily transformation, characters impaled with oversized feathers, and references to torture and its aftermath. Human survivors can also be harmed or killed by the player or by enemies.
